facts: Default AssemblyConfig uses max_candidates=256, mature_episodes=3, stale_after_ms=50000 and immature_stale_episodes=2.
At capacity, a novel unmatched candidate triggers prune() and is refused if capacity remains full.
The only current v0.5 prune path removes stale candidates only while episode_count <= immature_stale_episodes; default mature candidates therefore have no reclamation path.
Stable supported docs/tests/callers do not define max_candidates as lifetime mature-memory, active working set, or cache and do not explicitly make mature candidates permanent.
V05_MASTER_PLAN mentions Assembly stability/decay plus candidate decay and candidate budget, but does not bind mature-candidate reclamation semantics.
Supported/default callers do not override max_candidates=256.
Retained learning horizons are bounded at 48 training episodes per seed and 24 ablation-training episodes; held-out evaluation does not learn Assemblies.
No supported test/caller promises continued novel-pattern acquisition after saturation and no default supported test deliberately reaches saturation.
Static source does not prove saturation unreachable because patterns_from_step may emit multiple candidate patterns in one episode.
Checkpoint persistence is state serialization/reproducibility behavior, not an explicit lifetime lifecycle contract.
